### Create Flight

## WE USE AUTOMODPACK!!
The attached modpack contains only the [AutoModpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/automodpack) mod, because it makes manging the server mods a lot easier! Once you have all the mods downloaded from the server on first join, you can choose to move them into a normal mods folder, as joining with AMP is not required!

![what is cf](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6911df46449d776d3bdfa7117ebfddc48e445d05.png)

_It's simply a server that is growing to be what I always wanted for a modded smp, create, ships, neat generation, and by far the most important, a dedicated community with people that love playing on the world :P_

## Other info

Some of the current community projects are, building up the spawn, and areas around it, along with finishing the train network & postal system. In terms of personal goals for members, I can't speak for everyone, but general stuff includes bases, ships, cities, etc!

War & fighting *are* technically allowed, however we have never once had a war or big fight, and griefing is not allowed under any circumstances, outside of a war that would be agreed upon. 

Currently we use Create Aeronautics

Other questions that I haven't thought of here would be more convienent to ask in the discord :P, which speaking of the discord;

### The discord has the application feature enabled
When you join, you will be asked the following questions:
- Why do you want to join our server?
- How did you find us?
- Reading and agreeing to the server rules

Overall, we're interested in some more dedicated people that can join and add to our community, whether its in the actual minecraft world itself, or talking with other members!

- iris/eve
